subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streaming treat the configured request timeout as an idle/progress timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling streaming transports?
rationale: The code path and sibling precedent support the fix, but this changes existing timeout semantics for Ollama users and lacks real remote-Ollama proof.

options.title: Require proof, then accept idle-timeout parity
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a short recording showing a remote or slow Ollama-backed OpenClaw run completing, then land the narrow refreshTimeout fix if proof matches.

options.title: Keep wall-clock timeout semantics
options.body: Reject or revise this approach if maintainers want timeoutSeconds to remain a total duration cap for native Ollama streams.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept idle-timeout parity
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a short recording showing a remote or slow Ollama-backed OpenClaw run completing, then land the narrow refreshTimeout fix if proof matches.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history in the native Ollama stream path affected by the timeout behavior.
